claims: C1 the Model Spec includes root-level rules and both user- and guideline-level defaults
C2 guideline-level defaults can be overridden by users or developers because user-level authority outranks guideline-level
C3 these defaults are helpful in many contexts but cannot apply universally

concepts.name: guideline_level_default
concepts.gloss: D is a default rule in the Model Spec operating at guideline level

concepts.name: user_level_default
concepts.gloss: D is a default rule in the Model Spec operating at user level

concepts.name: root_level_rule
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the Model Spec operating at root level

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: level L1 has higher authority than level L2 in the model spec's chain of command

closure.reason: the clause explicitly permits overriding guideline-level defaults when user-level authority prevails; it does not address other authority relationships or rule types
